raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "copy to"
  role subject "the nightly job"
  role object "s3://greenfield-archive"
  role source "the file server"
  role time "around 01:15"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "fail"
  role subject "the nightly job"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid on "this month"

@s3 stated
  relation "do a scrub"
  role subject "the Synology"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "coincide with"
  role subject "the failure of the nightly job"
  role object "the Synology doing its own scrub"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "send a notification"
  role subject "the backup setup"
  role recipient "whoever is on call"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "page"
    role subject "the backup setup"
    role object "whoever is on call"
    role condition "if it fails two nights in a row"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "send an email to"
    role subject "the backup setup"
    role recipient "the shared inbox"
    role condition "if it fails two nights in a row"
    polarity affirmed
  end
